title: Ali Baba trio and Toronto again, 1968-69
summary: He led a trio for eighteen weeks at Ali Baba on 59th Street in 1968, then took his own band with Dick Vance to Toronto in 1969.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: And then I went -- in '68 also I went to Ali Baba for 18 weeks of my own trio, you know, on 59th Street. And I had -- that was nice. I enjoyed that. I had a drummer, what was it? Skippy White on drums and the piano player that was with me for a while, and I had Sonny White playing piano.

And then in '69 I went to Toronto again. That was when I went -- I took my own band up to Toronto with Dick Vance and Jimmy Crawford and Benny Morton, and I think Sonny White went up there with me. And then I went to Africa.
